effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name and 1 blue Tamer card among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you play a blue Tamer, gain 1 memory.
